a.xlink:title: The socket fd linking this player to its client.
Starts an incantation: validates prerequisites, notifies the initiator and the GUI,...
Broadcasts text to every other player, tagged with the direction it came from.
Pushes every other player off the current tile.
Consumes one food unit per player and kills those who have starved.
Looks up a player by its client fd, or nullptr if none matches.
Attempts to start an elevation ritual on the current tile (see beginIncantation).
pin: reports a player's position and inventory.
plv: reports a player's level.
ppo: reports a player's position and orientation.
Removes a player from the world and decrease the number of slots occupied in its team....
Reads pending data from the client socket into the command queue.
Runs the blocking event loop: polls for I/O, accepts new clients, dispatches commands,...
Builds the world and network handler, then runs the blocking event loop.
Fills _aiCommands with the AI protocol commands and their durations.
Builds a parser for one client.
Handles the first line of an AI client: the team-name handshake.
Dispatches the next queued command if its time has come.
Broadcasts a message to all clients of type GRAPHIC (use for processing the broadcast command).
Returns the number of free team connection slots (the "Connect_nbr" command).
Lays an egg on the current tile, opening a new team slot.
Moves the player one tile forward in its current facing.
Returns the player's inventory (resource counts and remaining life).
Returns the tile the given player is standing on.
Drops a named resource from the inventory onto the current tile.
Picks up a named resource from the current tile into the inventory.
Turns the player 90° to the left.
Returns what the player sees on the tiles within its vision cone.
Turns the player 90° to the right.
Fills _graphicCommands with the graphic protocol commands.
Removes a client, its parser, and its fd from all internal structures.
